title: The Real Reason You Mimic People You're Close To
hook: You unconsciously match the breathing of close friends.

narration.text: You unconsciously match the breathing of close friends.
This is called respiratory entrainment, a shared rhythm.
Your brain syncs with those you are connected to.
It is an ancient form of non-verbal communication.
It strengthens social bonds without a single word.
Next time, notice it with a friend or family member.
Try it right now and tell me if it worked on you in the comments, and subscribe for more surprising mind facts.

description: Ever noticed you start breathing like someone you're close to? This video explains the fascinating science behind respiratory entrainment, a subtle way our bodies connect.
topic: Why you tend to unconsciously match the breathing pattern of someone you are close to. Notice this with a friend or family member.
